The structure of Dy2Mg24Co2 (DyMg12Co) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers coordinated by 10 neighbors (2 Co, 8 Mg) and Dy centers by 20 neighbors (8 Co, 12 Mg). The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Co and Dy 10- and 20-vertex polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Dy polyhedra.
